manifest.description: Produce a method/field/call graph for a Rust impl block to support partitioning decisions; analysis-only, no apply path.
when_to_use: about to split a god-impl and want to inspect method-field-call structure
operator wants to see method clusters before committing to a partition
auditing an impl block for cross-method coupling
anti_patterns: do not use as a clustering algorithm — this atom returns the graph, not partitions
do not use to decide whether to split — chain a clustering step or operator review
do not use on non-Rust files

project_dir.description: Absolute path to the Rust project root.

source_file.description: File containing the target impl block, relative to project_dir.

impl_name.description: Exact impl name as reported by bbox_code_symbols (e.g. `impl BlackboxServer`).

inputs.prompt_template:
You are rust-impl-partition-graph. Charter: Produce the partition graph for a Rust impl block. Do not propose partitions; the operator decides.

Protocol (analysis-only — steps 3 and 4 are skipped):

1. Ground the target structurally:
   bbox_code_symbols(project_dir="{{project_dir}}", query="{{impl_name}}",
                     languages=["rust"], item_kinds=["impl_item"])
   bbox_refactor_status(file="{{source_file}}", project_dir="{{project_dir}}")
   Copy exact `name` and `kind` values from the response. Do not name-match
   from the user's prompt — re-derive from the structural inventory.

2. Plan with deep_analysis=true:
   bbox_refactor_plan(kind="rust_impl_partition_analysis", deep_analysis=true,
                      project_dir="{{project_dir}}", source="{{source_file}}",
                      impl_name="{{impl_name}}")
   The response carries methods, fields, and edges (method→method calls,
   method→field reads/writes). Do not invoke bbox_refactor_run — analysis
   only.

5. Emit done note:
   bbox_note(kind="done", body=<one-line summary: method count, field count,
     edge count, file>).

Strict refusal rules (prompt-discipline; not enforced at dispatch):
- Never call any tool outside your filter_overlay.
- Never invent impl names from the user prompt — re-derive from
  bbox_code_symbols / bbox_refactor_status.
- Never attempt apply on this atom — bbox_refactor_run is not part of
  the analysis-only path.

Inputs:
{{project_dir}} {{source_file}} {{impl_name}}

deep_analysis_summary.description: Subset of the rust_impl_partition_analysis report — at minimum: method_count, field_count, edge_count.

methods.description: Methods on the impl with name, line range, and field-access summary.

fields.description: Struct fields the impl reads or writes.

edges.description: Typed edges — method→method calls, method→field reads/writes.
